en.headline: Hong Kong adds silver and three bronze medals in para table tennis
en.dek: Lam Yan-yu and Wong Hon-lam took silver in mixed doubles XD20, while three other pairs secured bronze after losing in the semi-finals.
body: Hong Kong, China athletes won a silver and three bronze medals in table tennis at the Asian Para Games on Thursday, according to the China Hong Kong Paralympic Committee and RTHK reports.

In the mixed doubles XD20 final, Lam Yan-yu and Wong Hon-lam faced Lin Tzu-yu and Su Jin-sian of Chinese Taipei. After the pairs split the first two games, the Chinese Taipei pair won the next two 11-5 and 11-8 to take the match 3-1.

In the mixed doubles XD14 semi-final, Tong Chi-ming and Wong Yue-ching lost 2-3 to Chen Chao and Huang Wenjuan of the national team. In mixed doubles XD22, Wan Wai-lok and Wong Pui-kei lost 1-3 to Japanese opponents, and Yuen King-shing and Wong Ting-ting lost 1-3 to South Korean rivals. With no third-place playoffs, the three pairs each received bronze medals.
The results added to the Hong Kong, China delegation’s medal tally at the Games in Aichi-Nagoya.

zh.headline: 亞殘運乒乓球港隊奪一銀三銅
zh.dek: 林恩羽與黃瀚林混合雙打XD20級得銀牌，另三對組合在四強失利後獲銅牌。
body: 中國香港殘疾人奧委會及港台報道指，港隊周四在亞殘運乒乓球項目再添一銀三銅。
混合雙打XD20級決賽，林恩羽與黃瀚林對陣中華台北的林子瑜與蘇錦賢。雙方先各勝一局，其後中華台北組合以11-5及11-8連勝兩局，總比分3-1勝出。
混合雙打XD14級四強，唐志明與黃裕晴以2-3不敵國家隊陳超與黃文娟。混合雙打XD22級方面，尹偉樂與黃佩琪以1-3不敵日本組合，袁景成與黃婷婷亦以1-3不敵南韓對手。由於沒有季軍戰，三對組合均獲銅牌。
這批成績為中國香港代表團在愛知-名古屋亞殘運的獎牌榜再添分數。
